rows.text: In the Lok Sabha on 17 March 1997 Shri Ram Naik (Mumbai North) said, in the official translation, that 'Shri Chintaman Wanaga is the only M.P. of that area. But he has not been represented in that Committee Shri Sharad Yadav is the working President of Janta Dal and his worker Shri Vilas Vichare, being the member of N.G.O.K., has been included in that Committee'.
